description: Run user tests and UX research without leaving your agent: draft studies (surveys, usability tests, tree tests, card sorts, five-second tests, preference tests, first-click tests, prototype tests), recruit participants from Your Panel, AI Panel, or GenPop Panel, and analyze findings and individual responses. Use the usersage-draft skill to create studies, usersage-recruit to launch recruitment, and usersage-results to analyze what came back. Every other plugin queries systems; this one queries people.
name: user-sage
